name: owner_nyam_first_bar_15

source.title: The 09:30 first-bar follow on NQ at 1:1 (Claude, 2026-10-20): the afternoon sheet's exits on the opening bar, so the two legs of the first-bar book share one shape

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the New York morning (09:30-09:45 ET) closes up: market long at 09:45; closes down: short. Stop 30 points, target 30 points (1:1), once a day, flat at the pass's end (11:00). The same bar as owner_jj_cont_15m (JJ's 25/38 - 50/76 exits) with the afternoon leg's exits.

taught: [KN7j6NXXAio 1:33 / KHEQ5g55dQ4 11:57] every session open gets the same first trade

[Claude 2026-10-20] pre-registered as the morning leg of the first-bar book at the afternoon leg's 30/30; owner_jj_cont_15m is the same bar at JJ's exits (940 tr, 42.9 %, +$70; WF fails P6.2 / P6.4); primary cell pts30-r1
not_run: The 30 / 30 exits are the afternoon sheet's (1:1), not JJ's 1:1.5; the cells are the lane's own neighbours.
k 0.2 x ATR is the family's floor: effectively every day trades.
The pass ends 11:00 (the engine's nyam pass), so an open trade is flat at 11:00, not 15:58.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own.
